They have expiration dates on all sterile medical supplies like syringes, IV transfer sets, etc. I was told the reason is that the seals on the bags containing these products will deteriorate after a few years letting in ambient air and negating the sterility. Some of these products are as expensive as heck, too.

This is true if the items are in a cabinet or drawer. However, if you keep them in good quality sealing bags inside an airtight container, their sterility lasts much longer. My BOB has a decent medical supply. I keep 5 of each in an appropriate sized baggie then sealed in a locking container with O2 absorbers.
